title: Ex-BoE deputy governor chairs Fnality supervisory board as platform expands to euro and dollar
dek: Jon Cunliffe, former Bank of England deputy governor, was named to chair Fnality's UK board. Cunliffe joined Jochen Metzger and Ron Berndsen on Fnality Europe's supervisory board as the company plans to launch euro and US dollar tokenized settlement systems alongside its existing sterling platform.
author: Crypto Cronkite
key_fact: Jon Cunliffe, ex-Bank of England deputy governor, chairs Fnality's UK board as the tokenized settlement platform expands beyond sterling to euro and dollar systems.
bottom_line: The announcement names the leadership but omits material details on governance structure, central bank backing, and launch timelines for the euro and dollar systems. Watch for follow-up announcements on Fnality's concrete implementation plans and which central banks or regulators have formally endorsed the new currency platforms.
body: Jon Cunliffe, former Bank of England deputy governor, was named to chair Fnality's UK board, according to Cointelegraph. Cunliffe joined Jochen Metzger and Ron Berndsen on Fnality Europe's supervisory board as the company plans to expand beyond its sterling payment system to euro and US dollar systems.

Fnality provides tokenized settlement infrastructure, a blockchain-based alternative to traditional payment rails. The recruitment of three former central bank officials signals institutional-grade credibility for the platform's cross-currency expansion.
